about: Greater Victoria's bus roads (the key West Shore roads, plus every named major road buses run along: auto) and the typical bus speed along them by direction, day type and hour (km/h, stops included). src 'log' = measured from logged BC Transit real-time positions; 'tt' = the timetable's scheduled speed. The page compares live bus speeds with these to estimate congestion; it is not a traffic feed.
credit: BC Transit GTFS and GTFS-Realtime (BC Transit Open Data Terms of Use); road names © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
